lines.en: Every step I take leaves fire.
I walk on, hauling my frame.
I round the volcano's rim.

lines.zh: 我的骨头缝里冒着岩浆。
lines.en: Lava glows between my bones.

lines.zh: 我朝你走来，火先到一步。
lines.en: I come toward you, my fire arriving first.
I reach the water and it is gone.

lines.zh: 尾骨拖在地上，犁出一道沟。
lines.en: My tail bones drag and plough a furrow.

lines.zh: 石柱倒在我脚边，我走了出来。
lines.en: A pillar falls by my feet as I step out.
The ground cracks as I walk.

lines.zh: 我迈开前腿，灰尘扑到你脸上。
lines.en: I swing a foreleg forward and dust hits your face.
I stand, smoke rising off me.
Fire burns in my eye sockets.
I raise my neck slowly.
I wait for the volcano to stir.

lines.zh: 我的两根肋骨互相刮了一下。
lines.en: Two of my ribs scrape against each other.
I grind one foot into the ground.
I breathe, very slowly.
Lava runs down my frame.

lines.zh: 我嗅到活物的味道，就在附近。
lines.en: I smell something alive nearby.
I stand like a mountain.
My shadow is huge and black.
I lower my head level with you.
My teeth work at the air.
I roll my shoulders.

lines.zh: 热气从我牙缝里慢慢散出来。
lines.en: Heat seeps slowly out between my teeth.
My joints move one notch at a time.

lines.zh: 我弯下脖子，火滴在你脚边。
lines.en: I bend my neck and fire drips by your feet.
The fire in my sockets brightens.
You are so small at my feet.

lines.zh: 我把头歪过来，火从骨缝里漏出。
lines.en: I tilt my skull and fire leaks out between its cracks.
I am judging how many hits you can take.
I lift one foreleg.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向呼出热风。
lines.en: I breathe hot wind your way.
My bones rattle.
I slowly open my jaw.

lines.zh: 你退了三步，我一条腿都没动。
lines.en: You take three steps back; not one of my legs moves.
I slowly settle my tail.

lines.zh: 我停在离你两步的地方，没有动。
lines.en: I stop two paces from you and hold.
A piece of bone falls off.
I step back and hold.
My sparks scatter.

lines.zh: 吼声撞在洞壁上，久久不散。
lines.en: My roar strikes the cave walls and will not die.

lines.zh: 我身上的裂缝多了一道。
lines.en: Another crack opens on me.
I settle my weight lower.
I make no sound, only smoke.
My eye fire burns brighter.
I set my bone back in place.
I stare, neck lowered.
I sweep a glance, uninterested.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，连烟都算不上。
lines.en: What you hold is not even smoke to me.
I step on it and it melts.
I kick it into the lava.
The fire lacks nothing.
I lower my head and sniff.
I burn it to ash.

lines.zh: 我看了一眼，扭头就走开了。
lines.en: I look once, turn my skull, and walk off.
I lift my head back up.

lines.zh: 你举着的东西，在我眼里太小。
lines.en: Whatever you hold up is far too small for me.
You hit me like a rock face.
I am hardly shifted at all.
My heat pushes you back.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨擦过你，留下一道烫痕。
lines.en: My ribs graze you and leave a burn.

lines.zh: 我们撞上时，脚底的石板碎了。
lines.en: When we collide, the slabs underfoot shatter.
I cast a glance down at you.

lines.zh: 你被弹开，脚跟刨出两道沟。
lines.en: You are knocked back, heels digging two furrows.

lines.zh: 我被撞的地方落了一层灰。
lines.en: Ash falls where you struck.
I set my foot down slowly.
I have no reaction whatever.
Two vast skeletons stand side by side.
Our skulls touch.
Our fires merge into one.
We circle the crater together.

lines.zh: 两具骨架并排，火照着彼此。
lines.en: Two skeletons side by side, lit by each other's fire.
We raise our heads together.
There is only the sound of fire between them.
We walk toward the lava together.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在地上叠住。
lines.en: Our shadows merge on the ground.
Neither of us lowers our head.
I take up a stone in my jaws.

lines.zh: 指骨一合，它就碎成了粉末。
lines.en: My finger bones close and it crumbles to powder.

lines.zh: 我一甩头，它划过一道弧落下去。
lines.en: A toss of my head sends it arcing down.
It glows red in my claws.
I look and drop it.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，一路刮出痕迹。
lines.en: I bite it and drag it, gouging a trail.

lines.zh: 一脚下去，它和石板成了一体。
lines.en: One stamp and it merges with the flagstone.
I bite it cleanly into halves.

lines.zh: 爪尖一按，它就在我脚下裂开。
lines.en: One press of a claw and it splits underfoot.
I drop it at your feet.
I turn my head fully to you.
The fire on me flares.

lines.zh: 我把重心挪到前腿，朝你压来。
lines.en: I shift my weight onto my forelegs and bear down on you.
The volcano stirs.
I lower my head slowly.
My sockets glow at you.
I am no longer merely standing.
You are lit by my fire.
I lift my foot.

lines.zh: 从火山口到洞口，都是我的地。
lines.en: From the crater to the cave mouth, it is mine.
I have come to a stop before you.
I begin drawing that breath.
All my bones creak.
You hear something under the ground.
I take one great stride.
The fire has already closed in.
I settle my weight forward.
I am about to roar.

lines.zh: 你跑过的地方，热气还没有散。
lines.en: The heat still hangs where you ran.
Wherever you run, the ground cracks.
I skirt the lava, steady.
You hide in a cave; I block the mouth.
My heat keeps spreading your way.

lines.zh: 我每步隔三息，从不落后。
lines.en: One step every three breaths, and never behind.
I lower my head to find you.

lines.zh: 你身后只剩岩浆的红光。
lines.en: Behind you there is only the red glow of lava.

lines.zh: 我走近一步，火就旺一分。
lines.en: Each step of mine brightens the fire.

lines.zh: 我抬脚跨过你，把你罩在下面。
lines.en: I step over you and stand above.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头在我身上响。
lines.en: You hear my bones rattle.
I have cut your retreat with lava.
I am only three blocks from you.
I slowly open my jaw.
Your armor is baked hot.

lines.zh: 你的箭扎进我腿骨，我照样走。
lines.en: Your arrow sticks in my leg bone; I keep walking.
No hurry; you will tire.
The flames follow with me.
You hear nothing but fire.

lines.zh: 我数着你还剩几块石头。
lines.en: I count the stones you have left.
I bring a claw down.
My skull rams you.
I sweep my tail across.
I stomp down beside you.
My teeth clamp your armor.
You are sent hurtling away.

lines.zh: 我的火贴上来，烧穿你的袖。
lines.en: My fire clings and burns through your sleeve.
I bite and shake my head.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过，石柱断成两截。
lines.en: My tail sweeps through and a pillar snaps in two.
You block a claw and slide three blocks.

lines.zh: 我张口咬下，牙缝里全是火。
lines.en: I bite down with fire in every gap between my teeth.
My bony tail cracks your back.

lines.zh: 你被我的重量带到地上。
lines.en: My weight takes you to the ground.
I roar, very loud.
The ground suddenly turns hot.

lines.zh: 一具巨大的骨架站起来。
lines.en: A vast skeleton stands up.
The crater's edge glows.

lines.zh: 岩浆顺着我肋骨的沟往下流。
lines.en: Lava runs down the grooves of my ribs.

lines.zh: 整个洞的温度翻了一倍。
lines.en: The whole cave's temperature doubles.

lines.zh: 你听见骨头拼合的声音。
lines.en: You hear bones fitting together.

lines.zh: 我站起来，洞顶低得擦过我的背。
lines.en: I rise and the ceiling scrapes along my back.

lines.zh: 我开始在这片火山里走动。
lines.en: I begin walking this volcanic place.
The volcano spits once.
I breathe out smoke.

lines.zh: 我的骨头从地里冒出来。
lines.en: My bones rise from the ground.
The stone here starts to crack.
Firelight fills the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 烟还没散，我的脚已经落地。
lines.en: The smoke has not cleared and my foot is already down.
Water turns to stone at my feet.
I begin to breathe.
The air turns very dry.

lines.zh: 我先抬起一只眼窝，再抬另一只。
lines.en: One socket lifts first, then the other.
You hear heavy footsteps.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆池里被推上来。
lines.en: I am pushed up out of the lava pool.

lines.zh: 火吃不动我，只是更亮些。
lines.en: Fire cannot eat me; it only makes me brighter.

lines.zh: 我从高处落进坑里，砸出巨响。
lines.en: I fall from a height into a pit with a crash.
The water hisses against me.
The blast opens my bone seams.

lines.zh: 一支箭弹开，留了个白点。
lines.en: An arrow bounces off, leaving a white mark.

lines.zh: 那股力量压住了我的火。
lines.en: That force smothers my fire.
I do not hunger; I only burn.

lines.zh: 雷打进我的骨架，全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning runs through my frame and lights it.
The ground is gone; I fall whole.
